note: Every agent run escalated rather than spending. All three tickets reached 'resolved' only after a named human approved the money that moved.

resolved_tickets.subject: Bulldog tee
resolved_tickets.outcome: Paid the overdue $840.00 reprint invoice to release the rush reprint, booked 12 units of CC-TEE-WHITE size S into stock, and closed the order as fillable.

agent_contributions.role: Read the ticket, routed it to three desks, and made the call
agent_contributions.contribution: One get_ticket call returned the ticket plus stock (S=0), pricing, and linked invoice 501 with its vendor. Delegated to inventory, then accounting, then customer service last, and closed the ticket as escalated rather than authorising payment.

agent_contributions.finding: Stock is 0 with a shortfall of 1. Invoice 501 is specifically a rush reprint of CC-TEE-WHITE S, so the order can be filled once that reprint is received and booked — but the invoice record does not confirm the delivery date.

manual_approvals.memo: T101: release overdue reprint for Tauhid Zaman
manual_approvals.why: The agents established the reprint was already on order but would not pay on their own authority with rent two days out. A human accepted the $160 end position in exchange for clearing a 3-day-overdue bill and unblocking the customer.

manual_approvals.reason: T101: reprint received from Bulldog Print Co
manual_approvals.why: Booking received goods in is a stock movement, not a cash movement — the $840 had already been paid on the invoice.

resolved_tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
resolved_tickets.outcome: Bulk order of 20 declined on supply: only 8 of 20 CC-HOOD-NAVY size M exist. Offered the 8 in stock at $50.00/unit, which clears the $22.00 cost floor. No discount approved below cost and no cash moved.
resolved_tickets.stock_effect: none — stock not committed until the club accepts

agent_contributions.role: Routed supply before price, then decided
agent_contributions.contribution: Asked inventory before accounting — the ticket presents as a pricing question but the shop cannot supply the order, so pricing 20 units would have been meaningless. Consulted customer service last.

agent_contributions.role: Exposed the shortfall that reframed the whole ticket
agent_contributions.delegated_question: CC-HOOD-NAVY size M has 8 in stock for a requested quantity of 20 (shortfall 12). Can we supply the missing 12, and if so when? Is any reprint or restock already on order?
agent_contributions.finding: 8 on hand against 20 requested, a shortfall of 12. No invoice or restock is linked to the ticket, so nothing is already on order. The apparel vendor's lead time is 5 days.

find_vendor: Bulldog Print Co, apparel reprint, lead_days=5, open invoice total=$840.00

agent_contributions.role: Established the discount floor and scored a specific price
agent_contributions.delegated_question: What bulk unit price, if any, clears cost and is acceptable, and should this discount be escalated given the reprint?
agent_contributions.finding: $50.00 per unit clears cost: $8.00 (13.79%) below the $58.00 list, leaving $28.00 margin per hoodie and $560.00 total margin on 20 units. Flagged that the vendor already has an overdue $840.00 invoice.

agent_contributions.finding: 8 size-M hoodies are on hand against a 20-unit request, leaving 12 unavailable. List price is $58 per hoodie and no bulk quote is recorded yet.

manual_approvals.why: This is an outbound sale, so no money leaves the shop. Stock was deliberately not committed with adjust_stock: reserving the 8 before the Yale AI Club accepts would strand inventory that another customer could buy.
